title: Urban Zulu and '100 Reasons to Stay Single in Lagos': Telling African stories on their own terms
summary: Africa's creative industries are attracting growing international attention, from fashion and film to television and music. But as African stories reach audiences around the world, a bigger question is emerging: who gets to tell those stories, and who gets to shape how the continent is seen? At FAME Week Africa in Cape Town, arts24 met some of the creatives…
